A01: isolate kernel-test SDK installation and reject legacy reuse

Install kernel-test cargo-osdk into its guarded private 0700 prefix and invoke that binary directly. Reject legacy skip-install before output or lock creation so another source root's SDK cannot silently produce test results.

Validation: eleven pure in-process isolation tests, independent source review and unchanged lifecycle helper bytes; staged diff check passes. Real kernel-test suites are recorded separately after this source commit.
